commands.evaluate: PYTHONPATH=src python3 tools/safe_margin_think_loss_veto.py --train-input data/materialized/train/inputs.json --train-outcomes data/train/outcomes.json --dev-input data/materialized/dev/inputs.json --dev-outcomes data/dev/outcomes.json --artifact experiments/safe-margin-think-loss-veto/artifact.v1.json --report experiments/safe-margin-think-loss-veto/report.v1.json
commands.reproduce: PYTHONPATH=src python3 tools/safe_margin_think_loss_veto.py --train-input data/materialized/train/inputs.json --train-outcomes data/train/outcomes.json --dev-input data/materialized/dev/inputs.json --dev-outcomes data/dev/outcomes.json --artifact build/safe-margin-think-loss-veto/artifact.v1.json --report build/safe-margin-think-loss-veto/report.v1.json

decision_space.allowed_transition: Premium axk1-think to ax31 downgrade for an entire existing safe-margin content group

dev_gate.access_condition: at least one candidate passes every Train gate

runtime_additions: safe-margin predicted axk1-think minus ax31 gain
safe-margin predicted axk1-think minus ax31 conservative cost
safe-margin predicted axk1-think gain-per-step-load efficiency bucket

fitting_and_bound.bound_definition: For each head and content group, upper = mean(linear prediction) + q90 of nested group-mean residuals (actual group-mean think-minus-ax31 gain minus predicted group-mean gain). A negative vote is upper < 0.0.
fitting_and_bound.head_definitions: Head h in [0,8] uses every representation-B feature whose zero-based index modulo 9 is not h.
fitting_and_bound.linear_model: standardized ridge regression with an unpenalized target-mean intercept
fitting_and_bound.standardization: fit-row population mean and population standard deviation; scales <= 1e-12 are replaced by 1.0
fitting_and_bound.target: actual per-episode axk1-think score minus ax31 score
fitting_and_bound.tie_handling: upper == 0 is not a vote; exactly the candidate minimum vote count is sufficient

grouping_and_honesty.content_group_key: the existing safe-margin think-stage key: (efficiency_bucket, content_signature), computed by the unchanged safe-margin helpers
grouping_and_honesty.evaluation: For each of the nine outer source/task families, run safe-margin on the complete Train batch, evaluate only that family's complete content groups, and create its veto decisions only from models and calibration residuals that exclude the outer family.
grouping_and_honesty.inner_calibration: Within an outer fold, predict each of the other eight families from a ridge fit on the remaining seven families. Aggregate residuals by complete content group. Each inner fit purges every fitting row whose content-group key occurs in its calibration family.
grouping_and_honesty.outer_fit: Fit each head on all rows from the other eight families after purging every fitting row whose content-group key occurs in the outer evaluation family.
grouping_and_honesty.overlap_fail_closed: A group key spanning an evaluation/calibration boundary is evaluation-side only and is purged from fitting. A group key spanning two calibration families remains separate family-owned calibration observations and never enters either family's inner fit.
required_assertions: all nine declared families are present
outer fit and evaluation families are disjoint
inner fit and calibration families are disjoint
no content-group key crosses fitting/calibration/evaluation boundaries after purge
every prediction used in a held-out family metric excludes that family
every veto is atomic over its complete safe-margin think content group

report_schema.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, indent=2, keys sorted, allow_nan=false, one trailing newline; paths are repository-relative

runtime_artifact.corrupt_missing_or_mismatched: fail closed to an unchanged safe-margin submission
runtime_artifact.full_train_calibration: Each head receives nested leave-one-family-out group residuals: the calibration family is excluded from its fit and overlapping group keys are purged. The shipped head coefficients are then fit on all Train rows.
runtime_artifact.full_train_overlap_note: Dev inputs are checked for content-group overlap with Train inputs before Dev outcomes are opened; any overlap fails closed without Dev outcome access.
runtime_artifact.threshold: the selected Train candidate threshold, or null when no candidate passes

safety_gate.method: repository risk-validation deterministic 5000-resample prompt-composition method, paired with unchanged safe-margin selections
required: zero tier-cap breaches for Fast, Balanced, and Premium
candidate realized cost-ratio p99 <= unchanged safe-margin realized cost-ratio p99 for every tier
candidate realized cost-ratio max <= unchanged safe-margin realized cost-ratio max for every tier

selection_rule: Among candidates passing every Train gate, select the greatest weighted-score improvement; ties at exact stored precision select the larger minimum vote count (9 before 8 before 7). Select at most one.

train_gate.actual_vetoed_gain: row-weighted mean actual axk1-think-minus-ax31 score over all vetoed episodes is strictly < 0.0
train_gate.zero_delta_definition: exact Decimal score equality after repository scoring arithmetic
